- 6/21 (30m) Commercial readout w/ Marissa — confirm list of SKUs and pricing delta for uplift.
- 6/25 (60m) Exec QBR — readout + sign-off path.

Action items for KeepCloud: please share Ravi and Melissa’s contact info, and a 90-day traffic projection (avg and 95th percentile token/sec if available). If that schedule looks good, I’ll send calendar invites and update the MAP with target owners.

Sergio
